name: Christmas Island
summary: Divided diagonally into blue and green, with the Southern Cross on blue, a golden bosun bird on green, and a yellow disc showing a green map of the island.
origin: The flag was designed by Tony Couch, a resident, after a 1986 competition, and adopted on Australia Day 1986. It became the official flag of the territory in 2002.

symbols.name: Southern Cross
symbols.meaning: Australia, and the island's place in the southern hemisphere.

symbols.name: Map
symbols.description: A green map of the island on a yellow disc.

facts: The island is famous for the annual migration of tens of millions of red crabs.
It was named by Captain William Mynors, who passed it on Christmas Day 1643.
The golden bosun bird is found only there.
clues: Blue and green diagonal halves with the Southern Cross, a golden bird and a map in a yellow disc.
Its island is known for its red crab migration.
Named after the day it was sighted in 1643.
